title: Common definitions
description: Shared vocabulary reused across all core and domain schemas. Domain-agnostic by design: nothing here may reference skiing, property or Japan.

claim_type.title: Claim type
claim_type.description: How a value came to be known. Never present an ESTIMATE as a FACT.

confidence.title: Confidence
confidence.description: How much weight a value can bear. Propagates: a score built on low-confidence inputs is low confidence.

reliability_tier.title: Source reliability tier
reliability_tier.description: 1 = national government/official statistics; 6 = community/anecdotal. See ARCHITECTURE.md section 4.

fx_conversion.title: FX conversion
fx_conversion.description: A currency conversion is only meaningful with the rate and the date of that rate. An AUD figure without them is uninterpretable a year later.

rate.description: Units of to_currency per one unit of from_currency.

rate_source_id.description: Source register ID for the rate itself.

money.title: Money
money.description: An amount in its original currency, optionally with a conversion. The original is never discarded.

range_high.description: Estimates are ranges. Do not manufacture precision.

transformation.title: Transformation
transformation.description: Any change applied between the published value and the stored value. Conversions are recorded, never applied silently.

applied_by.description: Script or agent that applied it.

provenance.title: Provenance
provenance.description: Attached to any value that must be auditable back to a URL and a date.

source_id.description: Must exist in the source register.

record_meta.title: Record metadata
record_meta.description: Bookkeeping common to every stored record.

supersedes.description: ID of the record this replaces. Corrections append and point back; they never edit in place.

unit.description: Unit as published, verbatim. Normalisation is a recorded transformation, not an assumption.
